PRESIDENT'S ORDER 8 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 8 OF 1979
PREPARATION OF ELECTORAL
ROLLS (FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April 1979]
No. F. 17 (2)/79-Pub.-The following order made by the
President is hereby published for general information :--
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order 1977 (C. M. L. A.
Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that
behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :--
1. Short title, application
and commencement.-(1)
This Order may be called the Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally
Administered Tribal Areas) (Amendment) Order, 1979.
(2) It applies only in respect of the forthcoming
election to the National Assembly.
(3) It shall come into force at once.
2. Amendment of Article 3,
P. O. No. 1 of 1975.--In
the Preparation of Electortoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas)
Order. 1975 [P. O. No. 1 of 1975], hereinafter referred to as the said Order,
in Article 3, in clause (2), for the proviso the following shall be
substituted, namely ;---
"Provided that, for the purpose of the general
election to the National Assembly to be held in pursuance of the Houses of
Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P (P. P.) O. No.
5 of 1977], or an election to a seat falling vacant before the holding of the
subsequent general election to the National Assembly, paragraphs (a) and (b)
shall have effect as if for the word eighteen therein the word twenty-one were
substituted."
3. Amendment of Article 7,
P. O. No. 1 of 1975. In
the said Order, in Article 7, the words, comma and figure "but
notwithstanding such repeal, an electoral roll for any constituency prepared
under the said Order shall continue in force until the electoral roll prepared
under this Order for such contingency has been prepared under Article 3"
shall be omitted.
